findings.text: The new dependency check lacks a negative regression for package-style imports and skips `from conformance import replay_tiers`, allowing undeclared frontend dependencies in that module to pass. Fix: resolve imported submodules and add a regression that rejects an undeclared dependency reached through this import form.
`build-support/README.md` still describes seven targets and excludes only `model` from development checks. Fix: update it to describe all nine targets and the exclusion of both `model` and `frozen`.
The new `CONFORMANCE_SUITES` and `LOCAL_PACKAGES` policy lists have no docstrings. Fix: document why each list defines the dependency check’s scope.

The new `imported_modules`, `module_file`, `import_closure`, and `declared_frontend` docstrings describe their results without explaining their purpose. Fix: state each helper’s role in detecting undeclared Nix inputs.
